messages:
Finn Harper: Hey team — Finn here, I started today on DevEx. Hybrid schedule (W/F remote). I ride a folding bike and stash it under my desk. I mess around with microgreen flavor pairings and am very proud of my bento Tetris. Quick q: where9s a good short walk with decent light for a lunch break?
Maya Sato: welcome Finn! The pier loop by 5th is short and sunny, benches too. For food: pho alley or the falafel cart midblock. :salute:
Keiko Tanaka: hi Finn 1: I run the plant exchange (usually Fridays). Microgreens are absolutely welcome. Small tip: label trays with sow date and water schedule so they don9t get re-gifted by accident. Also fridge rule: always put name + date on things (after the great curry mystery). :grimacing: 
Ari Park: hey! also FYI the espresso machine prefers a fine-but-not-too-fine grind. If you want a tour of the "under-desk cable maze" I9m your person. We even have a tiny, informal lunchtime yoga session on Tuesdays. :lotus: 
Sam (People Ops): Hi Finn 1: added you to building access, lunch rota, and the #team-shoutouts group. DM me if you need badge or parking help or a chair adjust. :handshake: 
Finn Harper: awesome, thanks! I can do a 5-minute microgreen tasting/demo during lunch — I9ll bring small jars and a cheat-sheet. Who9s up for a short river ride/walk after lunch on Thursday? My bike folds in 10s.
welcome-bot: Finn Harper joined #new-hires 1: welcome message delivered.
Keiko Tanaka: river ride + swap on Thursday sounds perfect. I9ll bring spare soil discs and labels. Also, quick poll: what snacks do people actually hoard at their desks?
Maya Sato: dried mango, always. :mango: 
Ari Park: instant oats, emergency dark chocolate, and a suspicious jar of coffee grounds. :coffee: 
Sam (People Ops): note: second-Monday onboarding Q&A exists, I9ll forward the invite. Welcome again, Finn!
Finn Harper: thanks everyone — see you Thursday 12:45 by reception. Bringing microgreen samples and a one-sheet. Excited to meet you all!
